rules.name: Keep fixtures inert and synthetic
rules.statement: Fixture tokens, repository states, configuration, and outputs are test data only; never copy live credentials, personal data, or private infrastructure values here.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Update the consuming test
rules.statement: A fixture change must name and pass the test that exercises its intended failure or success path.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.
